WITH grp AS (
  SELECT a.player_id, p.death_country, SUM(a.g_1b - a.g_cf) AS gsum
  FROM appearances a
  JOIN player p ON p.player_id = a.player_id
  GROUP BY a.player_id, p.death_country
),
overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(gsum) AS avg_sum FROM grp WHERE gsum IS NOT NULL
),
kept AS (
  SELECT g.gsum, o.avg_sum
  FROM grp g
  JOIN overall o ON o.avg_sum IS NOT NULL
  WHERE g.gsum > o.avg_sum
)
SELECT SUM(gsum) AS total_kept_sum, AVG(gsum - avg_sum) AS avg_excess
FROM kept
